answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent burns one deposit for a work slot, kept only by passing cipher challenges proving it is live; missing one forfeits slot and deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 100 live answers: 100 x 50 coins = 5,000 coins burned for nothing extra. Honest agents pay once and share rewards undiluted. Like juniper in thin soil, trust grows at real cost, so forgery stops paying.
